name: datascibench_human_12
description: Only input packaging has been performed. All original feature columns, IDs, constant columns and missing markers are retained. Analyze them in EDA and perform appropriate feature handling in FE fitted on training data only. This is an independent random-split experiment, not reproduction of the original benchmark. Original metric: 原多产物任务，见 prompt.json; experiment metric: f1_macro. Original field whitespace and '?' markers remain; inspect in EDA and handle feature markers in FE. Target labels retain their original whitespace. Use the provided frozen split. Do not repartition. Test labels are evaluator-only. No final refit on validation data.
